Yes, but only on the Enterprise plan, where users are provisioned through SCIM. This applies to both Black Mesa Nimbus and Black Mesa Orbit. [chunk:10266] [chunk:10246] [chunk:10257]

question: Massive Dynamic:a:outage-credit
reply: Yes. Massive Dynamic Vertex credits 25% of the monthly fee per hour below your plan's uptime target. This applies to the Enterprise plan in the US [chunk:10420], the Team plan in the US [chunk:10386], the Starter plan in the US [chunk:10399], the Enterprise plan in the EU [chunk:10414], and the Team plan in the EU [chunk:10394].

question: Massive Dynamic:a:user-invite
reply: Invite teammates from People › Invite. [chunk:10357] Invitations expire after 7 days on the Team plan in the US, APAC, and EU, and on the Starter plan in the US and EU. [chunk:10357][chunk:10393][chunk:10363][chunk:10329][chunk:10403]

question: Nakatomi:a:billing-refund
reply: Yes, Nakatomi Summit refunds unused seats within 30 days of purchase. [chunk:10463] Refunds go back to the original payment method, and this applies on the Enterprise plan in the EU, US, and APAC [chunk:10463][chunk:10496][chunk:10430], as well as on the Starter plan in the US [chunk:10451] and the Team plan in the US. [chunk:10488]

question: Black Mesa:a:sso-setup
reply:
To set up SSO, open Settings › Security › SSO. [chunk:10239] Upload your identity provider's metadata. [chunk:10239] Test with one user before enforcing it. [chunk:10239] These steps are the same for Black Mesa Orbit and Black Mesa Nimbus. [chunk:10282]

The plan you need depends on the help page for your product, plan and region. For example, Orbit lists SSO under the Starter plan in the US and EU, and under the Enterprise plan in the US and APAC. [chunk:10284][chunk:10319][chunk:10288] Nimbus lists SSO under the Starter plan in APAC. [chunk:10282]

question: Prestige:a:outage-status
reply: Prestige Vertex posts incidents on its status page and emails admins. This applies on the Starter plan in the US [chunk:10551], the Enterprise plan in the US [chunk:10581], the Starter plan in the EU [chunk:10514], and the Enterprise plan in the EU [chunk:10535].

question: Nakatomi:a:outage-status
reply:
Incidents are posted on the trust centre, and admins are also emailed. This applies to Nakatomi Summit on the Enterprise plan in the US. [chunk:10491] It also applies to Nakatomi Summit on the Team plan in the US. [chunk:10500]

Nakatomi Nimbus works the same way on the Enterprise plan in the US. [chunk:10459] It also does on the Team plan in the US. [chunk:10507] On the Enterprise plan in the EU, Nimbus does the same. [chunk:10450]

question: Virtucon:a:sso-cert
reply: When an SSO signing certificate lapses, logins fail closed. [chunk:10674] Admins are warned 14 days before the certificate expires. [chunk:10674] To fix it, rotate the certificate from the identity console and re-test. [chunk:10674]

question: Prestige:a:billing-tax

In both Prestige Vertex and Prestige Atlas, add a VAT number under Billing › Tax details. [chunk:10570] [chunk:10576]

It applies from your next invoice, and the chunks show this for the Team, Enterprise and Starter plans. [chunk:10570] [chunk:10576] [chunk:10555] [chunk:10561] [chunk:10560]

question: Virtucon:a:webhook-retry
reply: A failed webhook is retried 3 times with exponential backoff, and then the endpoint is disabled. [chunk:10668] [chunk:10689] [chunk:10688] [chunk:10672] [chunk:10665]

question: Duff:a:sso-scim
reply:
The chunks cover two products (Duff Pulse and Duff Granite), and both say the same thing: automatic provisioning through SCIM is available on the Enterprise plan only.

- Duff Pulse provisions users through SCIM on the Enterprise plan only. [chunk:10739][chunk:10759]
- Duff Granite provisions users through SCIM on the Enterprise plan only. [chunk:10728][chunk:10729][chunk:10713]

Deprovisioned users lose access within 60 minutes on the plans described (Starter, Team and Enterprise, across the US, EU and APAC regions covered). [chunk:10739][chunk:10728][chunk:10729][chunk:10759][chunk:10713]

question: Sterling:a:export-stuck
reply:
If an export has been running for more than 45 minutes, cancel it from the job console. [chunk:10641][chunk:10642][chunk:10651][chunk:10599][chunk:10626]

Then clear the export lock with `exports unlock --tenant` and re-run the export. [chunk:10641][chunk:10642][chunk:10651][chunk:10599][chunk:10626]

If it still fails after 3 retries, escalate to the on-call team for your region. For US that is the US on-call [chunk:10641], for EU the EU on-call [chunk:10642][chunk:10599], and for APAC the APAC on-call [chunk:10651][chunk:10626].

question: Duff:a:user-2fa
reply:

- Duff Granite, Team plan (EU): Admins can require 2FA under Settings › Login security, and users get 7 days to enrol. [chunk:10755]
- Duff Granite, Starter plan (EU): Admins can require 2FA under Settings › Login security, and users get 7 days to enrol. [chunk:10714]
- Duff Granite, Team plan (US): Admins can require 2FA under Settings › Login security, and users get 7 days to enrol. [chunk:10762]
- Duff Pulse, Starter plan (EU): Admins can require 2FA under Settings › Login security, and users get 7 days to enrol. [chunk:10744]
- Duff Pulse, Enterprise plan (EU): Admins can require 2FA under Settings › Login security, and users get 7 days to enrol. [chunk:10720]
